title: Topological Residual Asymmetry for Bivariate Causal Direction
summary: Inferring causal direction from purely observational bivariate data is fragile: many methods commit to a direction even in ambiguous or near non-identifiable regimes. We propose Topological Residual Asymmetry (TRA), a geometry-based criterion for additive-noise models. TRA compares the shapes of two cross-fitted regressor-residual clouds after rank-based copula standardization: in the correct direction, residuals are approximately independent, producing a two-dimensional bulk, while in the reverse direction -- especially under low noise -- the cloud concentrates near a one-dimensional tube.…
